title: RAW UNREVIEWED: held context-partner crossover distinguishes part term, plant name and treatment topic after visual association
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Conditional on a separately supported whole-word/image association, compare three joint generative role models using the complete admitted exact-form distribution, independent image-feature bags, and text-only construction contexts. The discriminator is which context-partner relations transfer when visual phenotype and textual partner class are crossed, not simply whether the candidate occurs on similar-looking plants. No candidate word or meaning is assigned here.

design.mechanism: A part term can recombine with several plant identifiers; a plant identifier can recombine with several part/quality expressions; a treatment topic can recombine with several materials while retaining a procedure-oriented context. These are alternative explicit language-production models, not universal facts derived from the labels alone.
design.unit: All exact-form occurrences of a candidate across all admitted selectors, separated by reader, within complete context packets; candidate chosen only by a prior frozen visual test and word-profile review.
design.contrast: Three finite models differing in which latent context class the candidate selects and which image-associated class remains stable: part/plant crossover, plant/part crossover, treatment/material crossover. Include an unconstrained association-only model with matched complexity.
design.prediction: Train role assignments on one set of context partners and visual-feature combinations, then predict unseen partner combinations and non-Herbal occurrence contexts under each model without assigning new per-occurrence senses. A model that fits the local picture but mispredicts broad distribution loses; any role-permutation equivalence is retained.
design.scope: RAW proposal; does not assume GDT1157 succeeds. Needs source-calibrated construction-role consequences from complete historical entries and actual crossover coverage, but no exact picture-to-word pointer or identical paragraph pair is logically required. Related IDEA15/27 seek part association, IDEA90 proposes paired heads, IDEA891 crosses visual properties, IDEA892 combines evidence channels; this proposal specifically holds out lexical context partners to compare three role types after selection. SCHOR_HEAD_PART_WHOLE_PLANT_SOURCE_COMPARISON remains ambiguous and cannot supply target meanings. Frequency/dispersion/grammar/repetition/counterexamples from words profile mandatory before instantiation. Medical metonymy or polysemy is not an automatic rescue; alternative finite polysemy models would require a new prospective contract. No target scoring or new admissions.
